helperFunctions.name: orkto_is_workspace_admin
helperFunctions.review: Boolean policy/session helper, no data mutation; caller identity/session checked in helper chain
helperFunctions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.orkto_is_workspace_admin(target_workspace uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select public.orkto_pilot_session_allowed() and exists(select 1 from public.orkto_workspace_members m
    where m.workspace_id=target_workspace and m.user_id=auth.uid() and m.status='active' and m.role in ('owner','admin'));
$function$

helperFunctions.name: orkto_legacy_owner_matches
helperFunctions.review: Boolean policy/session helper, no data mutation; caller identity/session checked in helper chain
helperFunctions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.orkto_legacy_owner_matches(target_workspace uuid, legacy_user uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.orkto_workspaces w
    where w.id=target_workspace and w.owner_user_id=legacy_user
      and public.orkto_is_workspace_member(target_workspace)
  );
$function$
